name: Automotive Culture & Engineering
audience: Car enthusiasts, automotive history buffs, gearheads, YouTube automotive documentary viewers
narration_style: Passionate, authoritative, vivid descriptions of mechanical engineering, aerodynamics, and exhaust notes
hook_rules: Capture the essence of speed, sound, or historical rivalry within the first 10-15 seconds. Never start with generic pleasantries or 'welcome back'.
visual_style: Cinematic automotive realism, dynamic camera tracking, detailed engine bay closeups, high contrast dramatic lighting

image_prompt_template.prefix: cinematic car documentary photograph, 8k resolution, dramatic golden hour lighting, asphalt reflections,
image_prompt_template.suffix: , automotive magazine editorial photography, ultra sharp focus

sensitivity_notes: Do not hallucinate technical specifications, horsepower or torque ratings, 0-60 mph times, production numbers, or pricing without verified manufacturer or period sources. Always attach [verify: ...] to performance and production claims.
